limitations.summary: No production authentication, authorization, RLS or ABAC enforcement is implemented.
Environment-referenced source values exist, but the validated defaults/TOML/env/secret-store configuration model is not implemented.
Deadline expiry does not interrupt detached compiler CPU, in-flight SQLite work or establish common database-native statement cancellation.
DESCRIBE has compiler-only tests but no end-to-end backend or endpoint result evidence.
Snapshot-local source identity exists, but there is no registry, coordinator or multi-source production caller.
Serving rejects known source-sized ORDER, GROUP, solution/term DISTINCT and graph-dedup Rust fallbacks before source I/O; bounded physical implementations remain unavailable.
The parser feature recognizes LATERAL, but both compiler paths reject it and no execution profile is implemented.
The PostgreSQL/MySQL evidence can skip on provider absence and therefore cannot establish production admission.
Live result-column probes and branch emission fail closed before cursor I/O, but the sequential preflight can race later DDL and is not a coherent schema-generation lease.
No sealed W3C RDB2RDF mapping execution matrix exists for MySQL.
The MySQL source-selector branch lacks a positive open_backend selector test.
Production telemetry, health/readiness, graceful shutdown and lifecycle controls remain unimplemented.
Recursive property paths use an exact finite-pair fixed point, but total work/cancellation budgets and live PostgreSQL/MySQL qualification remain open.

Compiler-only no-primary-key path SQL maps the synthetic `rowid` sentinel to snapshot-local PostgreSQL `ctid`; a real `rowid` column still collides and live PostgreSQL path execution is not evidenced.
Mutable product-mock PostgreSQL is an optional development differential. Its table/column inventory currently rejects drift and grants no backend admission.
The complete backend contract, live matrix, security, cancellation and conformance gates in ADR-0038 R3 are incomplete.

No pinned SPARQL Protocol manifest is executed; the tested read-only HTTP subset accepts exactly one query parameter for GET/form POST or one raw query body, rejects dataset/version/extra parameters, and is not full Protocol conformance.

The serving lane shares one absolute deadline and finite ceilings for observable metadata probes, branch opens, pull attempts, semantic result items and serializer writes. Compiler CPU, database rows scanned, recursive SQL iterations/source cost, raw/conformance callers, a common source-native statement-cancellation contract and atomic/no-prefix post-200 responses remain outside the total QueryBudget required by M2.

Narrow private diagnostics include same-byte static RootPie preflight, a counterfactual non-authority bubblewrap name/path inventory, and late seccomp; actual host byte consumption/runtime closure, the minimal production dependency closure, and exact-artifact release proof are not implemented.

Explicit-R2RML serving quarantines unverified constraints and type-authorized pooling, while live result-column preflight fails closed; coherent structural/type generations, typed synthetic row identity, atomic reload, verified optimisation and Direct Mapping regeneration remain unimplemented.

Canonical semantic-builder gold and the sealed semantic-product-mock source are development authorities. The in-charter slice maps one table and proves neither image/source provenance nor backend admission.
Validated immutable snapshot reload and schema-drift readiness handling are not implemented.
Post-200 SELECT/CONSTRUCT failures terminate the body and may expose a usable prefix; they cannot become RFC 9457 responses.
Remote-source TLS verification and a production secret-store transport remain unimplemented.

Required strict-subset tests accept exactly one query for GET or form POST, or one raw POST body. Raw bodies have a per-request n-byte cap; form bodies have a checked per-request 3n+16 wire cap and n-byte decoded-query cap. Optional version, dataset, duplicate and extra parameters reject instead of being ignored; unsupported media rejects without polling the application body. This is not full Protocol conformance.

Required controls propagate every metadata error, reject missing/duplicate/ambiguous live columns, distinguish Table from Query identity, recursively overlay probed catalogs for base Table/Query sources during nested SubPlan emission, revalidate persisted shared-dedup scopes, and pre-emit every branch before any cursor opens. Probes are sequential and non-atomic; bounded lexical alias folding remains only for offline/synthetic emission and translate-time immediate wrappers, never live metadata authority. This is defense in depth, not drift detection or a generation lease.

One serving identity begins in Tower Service::call after HTTP/request-target parsing and before Axum route/method dispatch, then spans strict request admission, compiler and pool waits, the controlled executor, handler handoff and serialization with inclusive observable source/result/byte ceilings. Charges and terminal transitions are linearizable and internal accounting keeps its sticky first cause. At an expired representable handoff the public classification is always deadline/504; before it, non-deadline SELECT/CONSTRUCT failures remain deterministic redacted post-200 body errors. ASK rejects zero result capacity before backend match/acquisition, stops after its first final solution without truncating grouped input, and uses no global sort buffer for top-level ordering. Compiler CPU, database rows scanned, recursive SQL/source cost, raw/conformance governance, common source-native statement cancellation and atomic/no-prefix post-200 responses remain outside this slice.

ServeConfig owns one backend/compiler/cache binding whose CompilerSchema quarantines unverified PK, UNIQUE, FK, FD, NOT-NULL and cross-column type authority. Recursively probed live catalogs and unresolved result columns fail before branch I/O. Exact shared term-dedup captures the complete BGP key, including active graph variables, before projection; it crosses only physically key-preserving unary wrappers and is revalidated before metadata I/O. Fully ground overlap uses an exact SQL unit-relation pool. The remaining source-sized fallback is rejected by serving before I/O. PostgreSQL CTID substitution is base-table-only, but typed base-table row identity remains open. This is not a coherent structural/type generation, typed Direct Mapping lifecycle, federation or production admission.

claims.text: DESCRIBE CBD compilation has required compiler-only tests; this does not establish backend or endpoint execution.
Full SPARQL 1.2 Query or Protocol conformance is not claimed.
PostgreSQL and MySQL have live query and endpoint evidence, but those suites can still skip and do not establish production admission.

Sealed required-live PostgreSQL RDB2RDF execution records 57 passes, one documented deviation and five exact skips across 63 R2RML cases, plus 23 passes and one exact skip across 24 Direct Mapping cases; this is mapping evidence only and does not establish production admission.
Sealed SQLite RDB2RDF execution records 62/63 R2RML cases passing with one documented deviation and 19/24 Direct Mapping cases passing with five exact skips; this is mapping evidence only.

A coherent structural/type schema generation with typed synthetic row identity, atomic reload and Direct Mapping regeneration, total-resource-qualified recursive paths, bounded global operators, federation, total request governance, security/identity, observability/lifecycle and an exact production artifact remain planned.

The optional mutable product-mock PostgreSQL Style differential is distinct from static gold/source verification; its 11-database/112-table/598-column inventory currently fails closed on observed drift and grants no qualification.
None of SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL is production-admitted under ADR-0038 R3.

SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL compilers use exact finite-pair fixed points for recursive P+/P*; SQLite/PostgreSQL compiler-only evidence pins the tested no-primary-key physical-row path SQL shapes. PostgreSQL still uses a collision-prone synthetic `rowid` sentinel and snapshot-local `ctid`. Hostile required execution is SQLite-only; live PostgreSQL/MySQL qualification and total resource governance remain open.

Current Axum-router path, method, strict request-admission/body and mapped pipeline failures plus startup CLI surfaces are redacted. Unsupported media is rejected without polling the application body. Malformed request targets rejected before the outer Tower service remain outside this application boundary. SELECT/CONSTRUCT executor failures expose only a stable body error; correlation IDs have no telemetry sink and post-200 failures cannot become atomic RFC 9457 responses.

The serving lane carries one control identity from Tower Service::call after HTTP/request-target parsing and before Axum route/method dispatch through strict request admission, handler handoff and serialization, with one absolute deadline and inclusive ceilings for observable metadata probes, branch opens, pull attempts, semantic result items and serializer writes. Charges and terminal transitions are linearizable and internal accounting retains its sticky first cause. At an expired representable handoff the public classification is always deadline/504; before it, non-deadline SELECT/CONSTRUCT failures remain stable post-200 body errors. ASK rejects zero result capacity before backend match/acquisition, stops after its first final solution without truncating grouped input, and uses no global sort buffer for top-level ordering. Compiler CPU, database rows scanned, recursive SQL/source cost, raw/conformance callers, common source-native statement cancellation and atomic/no-prefix post-200 responses are not claimed.

SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL source selectors feed one immutable source/backend/compiler/cache binding; reachability is not admission. PostgreSQL introspection and unqualified base-table resolution are `public`-scoped and fail on schema/catalogue identity ambiguity. Explicit-R2RML serving quarantines unverified integrity constraints and prevents mutable startup types from authorizing cross-column PostgreSQL pooling. Every recursively reachable base Table/Query source is probed and its referenced columns fail closed before cursor I/O, including base-source references inside nested emission. Offline/synthetic alias folding and translate-time immediate wrappers retain a bounded non-SQL-token-aware heuristic, never live metadata authority. Shared term-dedup captures the complete BGP key, including an active graph variable, before projection, crosses only physically key-preserving pure unary wrappers, is revalidated before metadata I/O, and overlays only a private execution clone; unsafe scopes return `501`. Fully ground overlap uses an exact SQL unit-relation pool, and serving rejects the remaining source-sized fallback pre-I/O. Trusted raw `rr:sqlQuery` is not schema-confined, while TOCTOU-safe structural/type generations, typed row identity, atomic reload and Direct Mapping lifecycle remain open.

The in-repo required tests lock a verifier for 139 canonical semantic-builder gold artifacts and 171 files from exact semantic-product-mock revision 7c45292fccb8b88afe263e18de6806667ae18573; the exact external KAT is diagnostic because CI supplies neither root. Generated .metaharness copies are evidence only, and this static contract proves neither mutable PostgreSQL state, image/source provenance nor production admission.
External SERVICE and named non-enabled source forms are rejected before query execution or connector construction.

Credential-bearing PostgreSQL/MySQL source specifications can be supplied through a bounded environment reference; parsed inline passwords fail before runtime, file or network I/O. TLS, layered configuration, telemetry and external secret-store integration remain open.

Serving rejects known source-sized Rust fallback plans, including exact reconstructed-term dedup over complete pre-projection BGP keys, before backend selection or source I/O. Top-level ordered ASK is admitted without a global sort buffer; other source-sized states and ordered nested subplans still reject. Raw/conformance execution remains available and bounded physical serving implementations remain planned.

SQLite has required evidence for a strict read-only endpoint subset: exactly one query in GET/form POST or one raw POST body; raw per-request cap n, checked form wire cap 3n+16 and decoded cap n; optional version/dataset/extra parameters rejected instead of ignored; unsupported media rejected without application-body polling; ASK JSON, SELECT JSON/XML/CSV/TSV and CONSTRUCT Turtle/N-Triples/JSON-LD. Full Protocol remains open.
The simple SQLite streaming-CONSTRUCT profile has a required growing-source constant-memory benchmark; this does not cover global operators.
